items.raw_excerpt: Snails are slimy. But there's more to that goo of theirs than meets the eye. It's a fact that may help inspire the creation of new materials.
items.summary_en: Snail slime is sticky, but there is more to it than it seems. Snails can change their slime to be sticky or slippery. Scientists hope this goo can inspire new materials.
items.summary_ko: 달팽이 점액은 끈적하기만 한 것처럼 보이지만, 사실 그보다 훨씬 흥미롭다. 달팽이는 상황에 따라 점액을 끈적하게 또는 미끄럽게 바꿀 수 있다. 과학자들은 이 점액이 새로운 소재 개발에 영감을 줄 수 있을 것으로 기대한다.
items.title_en: Sticky or slippery? Snails change their slime to fit the moment

items.raw_excerpt: The AIUTUC on Thursday organised a district-level protest in front of the Deputy Commissioner’s office in Kalaburagi, demanding the immediate implementation of the revised minimum wages for contract workers
items.summary_en: The AIUTUC held a district-level protest in front of the Deputy Commissioner's office in Kalaburagi. They demanded that the revised minimum wages for contract workers be implemented immediately.

items.raw_excerpt: Several cities have recorded their coldest night this year as the cold snap continues to hit the country, while Timaru has recorded its coldest August temperature in 46 years.
items.summary_en: A cold snap is bringing bitterly cold mornings to New Zealand. Several cities recorded their coldest night this year. Timaru had its coldest August temperature in 46 years.

items.raw_excerpt: El joven es autónomo y con su tienda 'online' de fruta ha conseguido vender más de 40.000 kilos de fruta a hogares de toda España. Más información: Pablo Chiapella, actor de 'La que se avecina', crítico contra un "macrovertedero" en un pueblo: "No puede haber peor sitio"
items.summary_en: Marc is a 24-year-old farmer from a village in Valencia. He bought his first two fields at age 19 using his own savings, with no inheritance. His online fruit shop has sold more than 40,000 kilos of fruit to homes across Spain.
items.summary_ko: 마르크는 발렌시아의 작은 마을에 사는 스물네 살 농부입니다. 열아홉 살 때 유산 없이 모은 돈으로 처음 두 밭을 샀습니다. 그가 운영하는 온라인 과일 가게는 스페인 전역 가정에 4만 킬로그램이 넘는 과일을 팔았습니다.
items.title_en: A 24-year-old farmer bought his own fields with his savings
items.title_ko: 스물네 살 농부, 아르바이트 돈으로 자기 밭을 샀다
items.title_original: Marc, agricultor de 24 años en un pueblo de Valencia: "A los 19 me compré dos campos con mis ahorros, sin herencias" - El Español

items.raw_excerpt: For the past two decades, Karen Nanook has shared a bedroom with her adult daughter inside her elderly parents’ home in Taloyoak, Nunavut. All that time, Nanook has been on the public housing waitlist, but she said she has never gone up more than third in her list in her community.
items.summary_en: Karen Nanook of Taloyoak, Nunavut, has shared a bedroom with her adult daughter for 20 years. They live inside her elderly parents' home. She has been on the public housing waitlist all that time, but she has never moved up beyond third place.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 누나부트주 탈로요아크에 사는 캐런 나눅은 성인이 된 딸과 20년 동안 한 방을 함께 쓰고 있다. 두 사람은 연로한 부모님의 집에 함께 살고 있다. 그동안 줄곧 공공주택 대기자 명단에 있었지만, 순위가 세 번째 이상으로 오른 적이 없다고 한다.
items.title_en: After 20 years on a housing waitlist, this Nunavut woman is losing hope

items.title_original: This Taloyoak, Nunavut, woman has spent 2 decades waiting for housing and is losing hope

items.raw_excerpt: Commuters aboard the Cork to Dublin, or Belfast train can avail of a cool drink or a salty snack - but passengers boarding any other intercity service better come prepared, because catering services have never resumed since they were suspended in 2020 during Covid.
items.summary_en: Only Cork to Dublin and Belfast train passengers can still buy drinks and snacks on board. People on other intercity trains want the tea-trolley back. Catering stopped in 2020 during Covid and never came back.
